thread:
maria: quick favor — can someone run a small packetized-batch interference sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S? i'm seeing sporadic p99 spikes in staging when a light background job is present. need p50/p95/p99 for seq=1k/2k/4k, batch sizes 1/4/8, single-stream and multi-stream. kernel=6.1 driver=535 cuda=12.1. pls collect perf traces + nvlink counters. cc @jon @sahil :eyes:

jon: i can take h100 + a100 tonight. will spin an L40S run too if someone can grab access (liz?). plan: run `bench/sweep_packetized` with `--bg-load small-io` and `--collect perf,nvlink,dcgm`. quick command: 
```
./bench/sweep_packetized --model rli-small --seq 1024,2048,4096 --batch 1,4,8 --streams single,multi --bg small-io --out /tmp/pack-sweep-2061234567
```

sahil: ran quick on our dev pool (h100,a100,l40s) — short paste of numbers from the ci artifact (still rough):
```
H100  seq1k:  p50 12ms  p95 36ms  p99 78ms
A100  seq1k:  p50 18ms  p95 54ms  p99 120ms
L40S  seq1k:  p50 15ms  p95 65ms  p99 220ms  <-- noisy neighbor + nvlink thrash observed

H100  seq4k:  p50 48ms  p95 150ms p99 320ms
A100  seq4k:  p50 72ms  p95 210ms p99 480ms
L40S  seq4k:  p50 60ms  p95 260ms p99 980ms  <-- big tail when bg runs on same host
```

liz: yikes on the L40S p99. was the background job colocated on same pci-topology (same host / same NVLink fabric)? if yes, can you rerun with `isol_cpus=1` and `--bg-affinity off` to see impact? also grab `perf record -a -g` for the p99 window. :thinking_face:

sahil: yup colocated on same host for that noisy run. i'll repro with isolation in an hour. attaching quick nvlink sample from the noisy run — look at the rx/tx drops and link utilization spike.

ci-bot: artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal/runs/2061234567/packetized-sweep.tar.gz (contains perf.data, nvlink.csv, dcgm.json, latency.csv) :white_check_mark:

jon: thanks. if isolation fixes it we probably need two things: (1) recommend placement policy for L40S customers to avoid NVLink thrash for small background IO workloads, (2) add a guard in scheduler to prefer non-colocated placement for long-tail models. filing a followup issue after sahil's isolated run. :memo:

maria: perfect — after sahil's isolated run can someone drop the minimal reproducer + perf flame (top 100 samples) into the ticket and assign to eng-runtime infra? i'll use it to brief product. thx all. :thumbsup:

sahil: re-run started, collecting perf + nvlink. i'll paste p99 numbers when done. ETA ~45m.

liz: if the isolated run still shows tail, let's also capture `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` during the run to correlate power/encounter. small request: please note driver build id in the ticket (we're on 535.104.05).

sahil: update: isolated run reduced L40S seq4k p99 from ~980ms -> ~230ms. nvlink TX drops went to zero. marking bg colocation as root cause. uploading new artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/2061234567/packetized-sweep-isolated.tar.gz

maria: great repro. opening ticket now and assigning to @jon for scheduler placement followup and @liz for L40S placement guidance doc. i'll link both artifacts.

jon: acknowledged — i'll prototype a placement heuristic (prefer cross-host for L40S if model tail sensitivity high). will also add an auto-flag in Dedicated to opt-out of colocated background work.

maria: thanks team. we can close this thread once the ticket has reproducer + perf flame + proposed scheduler patch PR. :pray:
